name: Harden
notes: Pebbulk's move 2 (B). Pebbulk tenses up and its rocky hide hardens for 3 s: every blow it takes in that time does 50 less damage (defense 50: a 60-damage hit does only 10), though a blow always does at least 1. Poison and toxic still hurt as usual. It hits no one, so it never misses: it only works on the user (a self move, nothing else is hurt or paralyzed). While hardened it flickers dark grey (pal_flash_steel), and a ringing metallic clang plays when it hardens. A wild monster that uses its move 2 (the Alpha, later waves) hardens as soon as it is ready and attacks; the player's goes off at once. Charge: 10 s.
title: HARDEN
